papers.title_en: Quantum Versus Classical Machine Learning for Neuropsychiatric Disorders: A Feature-Matched Multi-Cohort Evaluation
papers.authors: Utsav Poudel, Anuj Nepal, Vyas Viswanath, Subramaniyaswamy Vairavasundaram
papers.evidence: 基于静息态功能连接的量子与经典机器学习疾病分类比较
papers.tldr: 静息态功能连接常用于神经精神疾病分类，但量子机器学习模型缺乏留站点验证与特征匹配的严格比较。本文在四个公开队列、4308名被试上，用相同相关特征对比六类量子模型与经典模型，并采用留站点或分层十折交叉验证。结果显示量子核与匹配经典核无显著差异，平均准确率差在1.4个百分点内；ABIDE I上部分量子模型AUC更高、训练测试差距更小，但无一致准确率优势。该工作提供284项匹配比较基准，并分析量子经典持平的有效维度与特征谱原因。
papers.abstract_en: Resting-state functional connectivity is widely used in machine learning-based classification of neuropsychiatric disorders. Quantum machine learning models have been proposed for functional connectivity data, but few studies have evaluated them under leave-site-out validation or against matched classical models. We compared six quantum model families with classical ones using identical correlation-derived features across four public cohorts (4,308 subjects). Leave-site-out validation was used for the Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange (ABIDE I), ADHD-200 (attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder), and REST-meta-MDD (major depressive disorder) cohorts, while the UCLA Consortium for Neuropsychiatric Phenomics (UCLA-CNP) was evaluated using stratified 10-fold cross-validation. The quantum kernel was statistically indistinguishable from a matched classical kernel across all four cohorts, with the average accuracy difference within 1.4 percentage points at 95% confidence. On ABIDE I, a hybrid quantum convolutional network achieved similar accuracy to its classical counterpart (0.645 vs. 0.641), while a trainable quantum kernel exceeded its classical counterpart by 0.064 in area under the curve (AUC). Quantum convolutional networks also achieved higher AUC than their matched classical networks on this cohort and showed smaller train-test gaps on all four cohorts, without an accuracy gain. Overall, most quantum models matched their classical counterparts, but none consistently outperformed them. This study, among the first quantum evaluations of ABIDE I under leave-site-out validation, provides a feature-matched benchmark of quantum and classical models comprising 284 matched comparisons. We further analyse fidelity-based graph construction and account for the observed quantum-classical parity through effective-dimension and eigenspectrum analyses.

papers.title_en: StimFlow: Synthesizing Brain Activity from Images via Stimulus-conditioned Flow Matching
papers.authors: Bui Van Hung, Dang Thanh Vu, Hoang-Son Vo, Mai Duc Minh Huy, Mai Tien Dung, Soo-Hyung Kim
papers.evidence: 在原生体素空间生成fMRI脑活动
papers.tldr: fMRI 响应跨试次变异大，传统生成编码器多在压缩潜空间、主要依赖语义特征，难为早期视觉皮层提供低层线索。StimFlow 在原生体素空间用条件流匹配与线性路径直接合成 fMRI，并融合 DINOv2 结构特征和 CLIP 语义特征以匹配视觉层级。单样本即达 0.371 体素级 Pearson 相关，匹敌五样本平均基线。它支持直接 ROI 分析与概念定位，仅一小时扫描即可恢复过半全数据性能，利于跨被试适配。
papers.abstract_en: The inherent variability of fMRI responses across trials encourages a generative view of the stimulus-to-response mapping. Prior generative encoders often operate in compressed latent spaces and condition predominantly on semantic features, which provide limited low-level cues for early visual cortex. We propose StimFlow, which synthesizes fMRI directly in native voxel space using conditional flow matching with a linear path. This design aligns training and inference distributions, enabling competitive performance with a single sample and reducing reliance on averaging. To match the visual hierarchy, StimFlow combines structural DINOv2 features with semantic CLIP features, which prove complementary along the cortical processing stream. With a single sample, StimFlow achieves a per-voxel Pearson correlation of 0.371, matching baselines that average five draws. Generation in voxel space allows direct ROI analysis and concept localization without a decoder. Furthermore, it recovers over half of full-data performance from just one hour of scans, supporting efficient cross-subject adaptation.

papers.title_en: DeepPV-MRF: End-to-End Partial-Volume Fraction Estimation from MR Fingerprinting Time Series
papers.authors: Tianyi Ding, Yang Gao, Zhuang Xiong, Feng Liu, Martijn A. Cloos, Jin Jin, Hongfu Sun
papers.evidence: 面向MRI神经影像的深度学习组织分数估计
papers.tldr: 磁共振指纹（MRF）中亚体素组织分数估计困难，传统字典匹配与分割流程会把中间参数图误差传播到最终分数。DeepPV-MRF提出级联时空网络，直接从原始MRF时间序列端到端估计脑脊液、灰质与白质分数，无需中间T1/T2图。在径向欠采样单次激发模拟中，其CSF/WM/GM平均绝对误差为0.0418/0.0744/0.0757，远低于PV-DM与PV-Pinv，结构相似度达0.960/0.916/0.922。体内数据也显示更锐利边界、更平滑组织过渡和更好的跨受试者一致性，为有限激发下直接部分容积估计提供高效方案。
papers.abstract_en: Background: Estimating subvoxel tissue fractions from magnetic resonance fingerprinting (MRF) is challenging. Conventional dictionary matching and segmentation pipelines can propagate errors from intermediate parametric maps into tissue fraction estimates.   Purpose: We introduce DeepPV-MRF, a deep learning framework that directly estimates voxel-wise tissue fractions from raw MRF signals.   Methods: A cascaded spatial-temporal network was trained on subject-derived Bloch simulations with radial k-space undersampling. The network combines temporal encoding and spatial U-Net refinement to estimate cerebrospinal fluid (CSF), gray matter (GM), and white matter (WM) fractions without intermediate T1/T2 maps. We compared DeepPV-MRF with partial-volume dictionary matching (PV-DM) and pseudoinverse estimation (PV-Pinv) using simulated and in vivo data.   Results: DeepPV-MRF outperformed both methods across acquisition settings. In single-shot simulations, CSF/WM/GM mean absolute errors were 0.0418/0.0744/0.0757, versus 0.1281/0.2443/0.2958 for PV-DM and 0.2021/0.2793/0.2630 for PV-Pinv. Corresponding structural similarity values were 0.960/0.916/0.922. In vivo results showed sharper anatomical boundaries and smoother tissue transitions, while cross-shot analysis indicated improved consistency across volunteers.   Conclusions: DeepPV-MRF enables accurate and efficient direct tissue fraction estimation from MRF signals, particularly with limited shots. Further validation is needed before clinical deployment.
